import heapq

class FlowNetwork:
    def __init__(self, vertex_count):
        self.V = vertex_count
        self.edge_indices = []
        self.adj = [[] for _ in range(vertex_count)]

    def add_edge(self, u, v, capacity, cost):
        idx = len(self.edge_indices)
        self.edge_indices.append((u, len(self.adj[u])))
        self.adj[u].append(self._Link(v, len(self.adj[v]), capacity, cost))
        self.adj[v].append(self._Link(u, len(self.adj[u]) - 1, 0, -cost))
        return idx

    class Edge:
        def __init__(self, source, target, capacity, flow, cost):
            self.source = source
            self.target = target
            self.capacity = capacity
            self.flow = flow
            self.cost = cost

    def get_edge(self, i):
        u, pos = self.edge_indices[i]
        forward = self.adj[u][pos]
        backward = self.adj[forward.target][forward.rev]
        return self.Edge(u, forward.target, forward.capacity + backward.capacity, backward.capacity, forward.cost)

    def list_edges(self):
        result = []
        for i in range(len(self.edge_indices)):
            u, pos = self.edge_indices[i]
            forward = self.adj[u][pos]
            backward = self.adj[forward.target][forward.rev]
            result.append(self.Edge(u, forward.target, forward.capacity + backward.capacity, backward.capacity, forward.cost))
        return result

    def _reweight(self, source, sink):
        self.dist = [4294967295] * self.V
        self.parent = [-1] * self.V
        self.parent_edge_index = [-1] * self.V
        self.in_spt = [False] * self.V
        heap = [source]
        self.dist[source] = 0
        while heap:
            v = heapq.heappop(heap) & 4294967295
            if self.in_spt[v]:
                continue
            self.in_spt[v] = True
            if v == sink:
                break
            for i in range(len(self.adj[v])):
                e = self.adj[v][i]
                if self.in_spt[e.target] or e.capacity == 0:
                    continue
                reduced_cost = e.cost - self.potential[e.target] + self.potential[v]
                if self.dist[e.target] > self.dist[v] + reduced_cost:
                    self.dist[e.target] = self.dist[v] + reduced_cost
                    self.parent[e.target] = v
                    self.parent_edge_index[e.target] = i
                    heapq.heappush(heap, ((self.dist[e.target] << 32) + e.target))
        if not self.in_spt[sink]:
            return False
        for i in range(self.V):
            if not self.in_spt[i]:
                continue
            self.potential[i] -= self.dist[sink] - self.dist[i]
        return True

    def pareto(self, source, sink, flow_cap=4294967295):
        self.potential = [0] * self.V
        self.dist = [4294967295] * self.V
        self.parent = [-1] * self.V
        self.parent_edge_index = [-1] * self.V
        self.in_spt = [False] * self.V
        total_flow = 0
        total_cost = 0
        last_cost = -1
        points = [(total_flow, total_cost)]
        while total_flow < flow_cap:
            if not self._reweight(source, sink):
                break
            bottleneck = flow_cap - total_flow
            node = sink
            while node != source:
                bottleneck = min(bottleneck, self.adj[self.parent[node]][self.parent_edge_index[node]].capacity)
                node = self.parent[node]
            node = sink
            while node != source:
                e = self.adj[self.parent[node]][self.parent_edge_index[node]]
                e.capacity -= bottleneck
                self.adj[node][e.rev].capacity += bottleneck
                node = self.parent[node]
            d = -self.potential[source]
            total_flow += bottleneck
            total_cost += bottleneck * d
            if last_cost == d:
                points.pop()
            points.append((total_flow, total_cost))
            last_cost = d
        return points

    def max_flow_min_cost(self, source, sink, flow_cap=4294967295):
        return self.pareto(source, sink, flow_cap)[-1]

    class _Link:
        def __init__(self, target, rev, capacity, cost):
            self.target = target
            self.rev = rev
            self.capacity = capacity
            self.cost = cost

import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class FlowNetwork {
        int V;
        List<int[]> edgeIndices;
        List<List<Link>> adj;

        FlowNetwork(int vertexCount) {
            V = vertexCount;
            edgeIndices = new ArrayList<>();
            adj = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < vertexCount; i++) {
                adj.add(new ArrayList<>());
            }
        }

        int addEdge(int u, int v, int capacity, int cost) {
            int idx = edgeIndices.size();
            edgeIndices.add(new int[]{u, adj.get(u).size()});
            adj.get(u).add(new Link(v, adj.get(v).size(), capacity, cost));
            adj.get(v).add(new Link(u, adj.get(u).size() - 1, 0, -cost));
            return idx;
        }

        static class Edge {
            int source, target, capacity, flow, cost;

            Edge(int source, int target, int capacity, int flow, int cost) {
                this.source = source;
                this.target = target;
                this.capacity = capacity;
                this.flow = flow;
                this.cost = cost;
            }
        }

        Edge getEdge(int i) {
            int[] indices = edgeIndices.get(i);
            int u = indices[0];
            int pos = indices[1];
            Link forward = adj.get(u).get(pos);
            Link backward = adj.get(forward.target).get(forward.rev);
            return new Edge(u, forward.target, forward.capacity + backward.capacity, backward.capacity, forward.cost);
        }

        List<Edge> listEdges() {
            List<Edge> result = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < edgeIndices.size(); i++) {
                int[] indices = edgeIndices.get(i);
                int u = indices[0];
                int pos = indices[1];
                Link forward = adj.get(u).get(pos);
                Link backward = adj.get(forward.target).get(forward.rev);
                result.add(new Edge(u, forward.target, forward.capacity + backward.capacity, backward.capacity, forward.cost));
            }
            return result;
        }

        int[] dist;
        int[] parent;
        int[] parentEdgeIndex;
        boolean[] inSpt;
        int[] potential;

        boolean reweight(int source, int sink) {
            dist = new int[V];
            parent = new int[V];
            parentEdgeIndex = new int[V];
            inSpt = new boolean[V];
            for (int i = 0; i < V; i++) {
                dist[i] = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
                parent[i] = -1;
                parentEdgeIndex[i] = -1;
                inSpt[i] = false;
            }
            
            PriorityQueue<int[]> heap = new PriorityQueue<>((a, b) -> Integer.compare(a[0], b[0]));
            dist[source] = 0;
            heap.offer(new int[]{0, source});
            
            while (!heap.isEmpty()) {
                int[] current = heap.poll();
                int v = current[1];
                if (inSpt[v]) continue;
                inSpt[v] = true;
                if (v == sink) break;
                
                for (int i = 0; i < adj.get(v).size(); i++) {
                    Link e = adj.get(v).get(i);
                    if (inSpt[e.target] || e.capacity == 0) continue;
                    int reducedCost = e.cost - potential[e.target] + potential[v];
                    if (dist[e.target] > dist[v] + reducedCost) {
                        dist[e.target] = dist[v] + reducedCost;
                        parent[e.target] = v;
                        parentEdgeIndex[e.target] = i;
                        heap.offer(new int[]{dist[e.target], e.target});
                    }
                }
            }
            
            if (!inSpt[sink]) return false;
            
            for (int i = 0; i < V; i++) {
                if (!inSpt[i]) continue;
                potential[i] -= dist[sink] - dist[i];
            }
            return true;
        }

        List<int[]> pareto(int source, int sink, int flowCap) {
            potential = new int[V];
            dist = new int[V];
            parent = new int[V];
            parentEdgeIndex = new int[V];
            inSpt = new boolean[V];
            
            for (int i = 0; i < V; i++) {
                potential[i] = 0;
            }
            
            int totalFlow = 0;
            int totalCost = 0;
            int lastCost = -1;
            List<int[]> points = new ArrayList<>();
            points.add(new int[]{totalFlow, totalCost});
            
            while (totalFlow < flowCap) {
                if (!reweight(source, sink)) break;
                
                int bottleneck = flowCap - totalFlow;
                int node = sink;
                while (node != source) {
                    Link e = adj.get(parent[node]).get(parentEdgeIndex[node]);
                    bottleneck = Math.min(bottleneck, e.capacity);
                    node = parent[node];
                }
                
                node = sink;
                while (node != source) {
                    Link e = adj.get(parent[node]).get(parentEdgeIndex[node]);
                    e.capacity -= bottleneck;
                    adj.get(node).get(e.rev).capacity += bottleneck;
                    node = parent[node];
                }
                
                int d = -potential[source];
                totalFlow += bottleneck;
                totalCost += bottleneck * d;
                
                if (lastCost == d && !points.isEmpty()) {
                    points.remove(points.size() - 1);
                }
                points.add(new int[]{totalFlow, totalCost});
                lastCost = d;
            }
            return points;
        }

        int[] maxFlowMinCost(int source, int sink, int flowCap) {
            List<int[]> points = pareto(source, sink, flowCap);
            return points.get(points.size() - 1);
        }

        static class Link {
            int target, rev, capacity, cost;

            Link(int target, int rev, int capacity, int cost) {
                this.target = target;
                this.rev = rev;
                this.capacity = capacity;
                this.cost = cost;
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int a1 = sc.nextInt();
        int a2 = sc.nextInt();
        int a3 = sc.nextInt();
        int b1 = sc.nextInt();
        int b2 = sc.nextInt();
        int b3 = sc.nextInt();
        
        FlowNetwork g = new FlowNetwork(8);
        g.addEdge(0, 1, a1, 0);
        g.addEdge(0, 2, a2, 0);
        g.addEdge(0, 3, a3, 0);
        g.addEdge(4, 7, b1, 0);
        g.addEdge(5, 7, b2, 0);
        g.addEdge(6, 7, b3, 0);
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= 3; i++) {
            for (int j = 4; j <= 6; j++) {
                int cost = ((j - i) % 3 == 1) ? 1 : 0;
                g.addEdge(i, j, Integer.MAX_VALUE, cost);
            }
        }
        
        int[] result = g.maxFlowMinCost(0, 7, Integer.MAX_VALUE);
        int ans1 = result[1];
        int ans2 = Math.min(a1, b2) + Math.min(a2, b3) + Math.min(a3, b1);
        
        System.out.println(ans1 + " " + ans2);
    }
}
